card.name: The letter h starting a split word
card.fires_on: The letter h (as h, -h, or H) that begins a word broken into pieces, especially where a hormone-type word follows, such as post-hysterectomy or non-hormonal.

modes.label: Hyphenated h-word
modes.description: A hyphen plus h after a prefix like post or non, starting a word like hysterectomy or hormonal.
modes.example: women treated post<<-h>>ysterectomy with estrogen-alone therapy.

modes.label: Standalone h start
modes.description: A lone h or H opening a word or acronym, often hormone or hubs.

card.plain: It fires on the opening letter h of a word that is split up, mostly hormone-related words like hysterectomy or hormonal.
